m. (pl.) [चुल् कर्मणि घञ्] N. of a country in southern India, in the region of the modern Tanjore. 
-लः, -ली 
__1 A short jacket, a bodice. 
__2 A garment reaching to the feet. 
-लम् A garment. 
-Comp. 
-उण्डुकः a diadem, turban.

__1 A breast-plate. 
__2 A bark-dress. 
__3 A bodice. 
-कम् Bark, rind.

m. 
__1 A soldier armed with a breast-plate. 
__2 The orange tree. 
__3 The wrist. 
__4 The shoot of a bamboo.

चोल(लो)ण्डुकः
A fillet for the head, a turban, tiara or diadem.
